hero.title: Your finances are personal.
hero.description: Organize accounts, transactions, cards, and installments without sending your financial life to a third-party central database. By default, data stays in this browser.

preview.ariaLabel: Illustrative preview of the Zevault financial dashboard
preview.title: Zevault — local financial database
preview.securityLabel: Your entries remain on this device by default

evidence.text: of Brazilian Internet users aged 16 or older are concerned or very concerned about how companies use their personal data.

benefits.title: Less exposed data. Less blind trust in third parties.
benefits.subtitle: Zevault reduces the need to share financial data: the primary database stays in your browser, and you choose when it leaves.

exposure.title: No central server holding your transactions
exposure.description: Everyday use happens locally. Your entries are not automatically sent to a Zevault database.

account.title: No remote account to protect
account.description: You do not need to provide an email, create a password, or maintain a financial profile on our servers to use the system.

transfer.title: Sync only when you request it
transfer.description: When changing devices, the optional transfer uses end-to-end encryption and a temporary remote copy.

features.title: Features to manage today and prepare for tomorrow
features.subtitle: From your first entry to a view of the coming months, every feature helps you understand your financial life.

accounts.title: Accounts and balances
accounts.description: Add your accounts and track a consolidated balance for one reliable view of the money available.

transactions.title: Income, expenses, and transfers
transactions.description: Record paid or pending activity and review everything in an easy-to-follow monthly list.

cards.title: Cards and installment purchases
cards.description: Track limits, due dates, and installments. Zevault spreads purchases across months so their future impact stays visible.

future.title: Commitments and future expenses
future.description: See upcoming and overdue bills plus projections by category, so you can act before your budget gets tight.

organization.title: Categories and cost centers
organization.description: Organize entries in a way that makes sense to you and discover where your money is being used.

backup.title: Backup and device transfer
backup.description: Export and import your data whenever you want, or use temporary sync to move your database to another device.

howItWorks.title: You decide where your financial data travels
howItWorks.subtitle: Protection starts by reducing collection and making every transfer an explicit choice.

setup.title: The database starts in your browser
setup.description: Accounts, cards, categories, and transactions are stored in this profile's IndexedDB, with no remote signup.

record.title: Normal use stays local
record.description: Record, review, and plan your finances offline without transmitting every entry to a server.

decide.title: You authorize every exit
decide.description: Export, import, sync, and deletion happen at your initiative — not as a condition for using the product.

privacy.title: Real protection, without magical promises
privacy.description: Local-first reduces exposure to a central database, but it does not make your device invulnerable. Zevault explains where each piece of data lives so you can make informed decisions.
privacy.local: Entries stay in this browser profile by default.
privacy.backup: The exported backup is your responsibility and does not have its own encryption.
privacy.sync: Device sync is optional and uses a temporary end-to-end encrypted copy.
privacy.device: Local protection also depends on the security of your computer, operating system, and browser profile.
privacy.exportDescription: Create a file to store or import later. The exported file is not encrypted.
privacy.syncDescription: Temporarily transfer the database between two authorized devices.

cta.title: Control your finances without giving up control of your data
cta.description: Manage accounts, cards, installments, and planning in a system that keeps your financial database in the browser by default.
cta.note: No signup, no credit card, and no automatic transmission of your transactions.
